act_card.doc: M3-C09-05 (act1_ch09.md §9 UI 2, B11): the title card on black between acts, and any other one-line title card on black (the Prologue's 'One month earlier.' is the same shape: ActCard.show_caption). The screen is black (back_color) for as long as the card is up; the words fade in over in_sec, hold for hold_sec, and fade out over out_sec, and then the black stays until the card is freed or hidden, so the next scene fades in from it. An act card is two lines: the act's numeral line ('Act II', label_key, BannerLabel small caps) over a centred gold rule and its name ('The Truth', title_key, TitleLabel). A caption is the name line alone. acts maps the act number (a string) to its keys. Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, pinned to the centre so the card stays centred at 21:9 and 16:10 (M2-UI-29). The words rise drift_px while they fade in (reduced motion: no rise).
